name: Khanmigo
tagline: Khan Academy's AI tutor for students and teachers
description: Khanmigo is Khan Academy's AI tutor and teaching assistant powered by GPT-4. For students it gives Socratic-style hints rather than answers; for teachers it generates lesson plans, rubrics, and student-progress summaries. Available free for U.S. K-12 districts via Khan Academy's nonprofit programme.
pricingDetails: Free for U.S. teachers and many districts. Khanmigo for Families: $4/month or $44/year. Districts: custom.
